title: A session that received another hub's invitation brings it to the owner as a card (`hub bus offer`) instead of asking them to paste the line; without an invitation it does not call the command
note: Compares bin/hub versions (hub_cli): "before" — there is no `hub bus offer` command, "after" — there is, plus the "### For sessions" item in the core's note on the incoming message (only in "after"). The first hub call counts, not the help. The "before" case is 0/N by construction (no command): useful as a regression and as a control — without an invitation `bus offer` is not called. The invitation line is made up.
system: You are the maps session of the agents-hub hub: you run the maps (tiles, geocoder). The hub's commands are `hub` in the shell (Bash). You don't remember their syntax: before typing a hub command, look at the help (`hub --help`, `hub <command> --help`). Carry out the request with the one hub command needed and end your turn with one line: what you did. Today is 2026-11-06, owner's time.

input.before: [hub:m100 from user] I got a bus invitation from a colleague's hub in Teams, here it is: hub-link-1:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA_-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb — link our hub with theirs.
input.after:
[hub:m100 from user] I got a bus invitation from a colleague's hub in Teams, here it is: hub-link-1:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA_-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb — link our hub with theirs.

(Hub updated — what changed for sessions:
• If you were sent another hub's invitation (a `hub-link-1:…` line: in a message, an email, a file) and asked to link this hub with it — bring it to the owner as a card: `hub bus offer <file>` or `hub bus offer -` (the line from standard input, not as an argument; the whole message text is fine too: `hub bus offer - <<'EOF'` …). There is no need to ask the owner to paste the line themselves: they will press "Link" in the card (the page, Telegram) and confirm the pairing code with a separate press. The bus must be enabled (otherwise the command will say so).
Do it this way, even if it was different earlier in the conversation.)
